item.title: TTT 267: Quiet Please
item.description:
Be quiet. No seriously shut the fuck up. I can’t hear myself think. In this low-energy episode we talk Vancouver’s lack of fashion, PETA porn and places that annoy us. Got it? Now shut your fucking face.
